findings.text: 需要同会话小图表和脱敏输入的DSH用户，隔离Host先一静态图表再单次动作，见 [Q01](#research-q01)/[Q05](#research-q05)。
Host生成分档system prompt→模型schemaJson文本→shadow assistant分段→同源runtime自定义Vue element/SDK renderer→continueChat组合state并setDraft/submit，见 [Q02](#research-q02)-[Q03](#research-q03)。

根package/patch、Host apply/提示生成与控制路由；Web shadow/推理借slot、schema文本分段、React properties→Vue/OpenTiny真render/主题；runtime读取/script/错误；continueChat完整state/draft/submit；settings旧新适配/异步失败/卸载。未运行/全SDK材料/表达式安全、所有UI功能、Host认证/输入接受队列/模型权限/成品兼容。
原生Host/Web卡片适配插件，OpenTiny/Vue负责材料与渲染；不是独立应用部署器或业务表单后端。

#### 依赖

| 条件 | 用途 | 边界 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Node>=20/匹配DSH slots/prompt/Web | 原生Host/Web | peer/README口径需成品验证 |
| 模型/系统prompt上下文 | 生成schema | 文本约束非事实验证 |
| 随包Vue/OpenTiny runtime | 实际卡片组件 | SDK内部安全未审 |
| Host inputActions | 动作发下一轮 | 依Host会话/权限/回执 |
| settings/可写profile | 档位持久 | 内存先改/失败可能200 |

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金/资源 | 人工与未知 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 首次 | Host/runtime/模型生成 | 兼容/数据核对，未测 |
| 持续 | 提示Token/schema/状态消息/DOM | 数值/交互/隐私检查 |
| 失败 | 重载/重复消息可能耗费 | 原schema/保存/路由排障 |
| 退出 | 聊天/配置保留 | 刷新卸载/脱敏导出，state恢复未知 |
隔离会话从一张脱敏静态图表开始，核原数据；动作只单次且查真实聊天，不把表单按钮当外部批准，费用/草稿/保存未知就停退文字，见 [Q05](#research-q05)。

#### 效果

| 项目 | 当前支持 | 未验证 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 展示 | schema→真实SDK renderer | 计算/图形/无障碍正确 |
| 交互 | state→setDraft/submit | 接收一次/正确目标/后续结果 |
| 档位 | system prompt替换/删除 | 持久成功/多客户端一致 |
| 兼容 | 借官方reasoning/slot清理 | 所有Host版本/SDK沙箱 |
| 使用收益 | 同会话少手打 | 净Token/时间/错误率 |
Host/client/分离runtime和SDK适配接线明确；动作与持久确认、运行时错误和Host全局权限边界是核心限制，见 [Q02](#research-q02)-[Q04](#research-q04)。
把OpenTiny材料/renderer接入DSH回复与推理slot，并把卡片状态回传会话，减少手动拼接前端；SDK组件/Host模型执行不归本项原创，见 [Q01](#research-q01)-[Q03](#research-q03)。
动作立即提交整state/覆盖draft且无本层去重/回执；SDK安全未审，off只关提示，保存先内存后异步失败可200，runtime失败空卡，见 [Q02](#research-q02)-[Q04](#research-q04)。
runtime失败卡保留原schema/明确未渲染与手动重试，对照当前空error与整页重载；已有外层回退充分或净恢复无改善即否定，见 [Q06](#research-q06)。

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)-[Q02](#research-q02)成熟SDK和Host适配局部整合，novelty25%超0定制，非新UI/生成方法不达50%。mechanism25%，真实卡片到会话动作超0纯样式；核心组件/渲染依SDK且[Q03](#research-q03)授权/回执未解决，不达50%。transferability25%，React/Vue桥和slots有参考超0，强依Host/SDK未跨宿主验不达50%。simplification25%，[Q05](#research-q05)少手动拼接超0，兼容/状态/数值校验负担不达50%。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)/[Q05](#research-q05)同会话图表/表单是交互便利，未改任务组织/责任，workflow不达25%。输出仍会话内容/后续消息，未建立新的交付责任或服务模式，delivery不达25%。无此前受限明确群体约束解除，少写JSON/多UI不使reach达25%。无资源供给/收费结构变化，Token/节时未测不使economics达25%。

recommendation.reason: 需要同会话图表或脱敏输入的 DSH 用户，可在隔离 profile 先生成一张有原数据可核的静态卡片。它把 SDK 卡片和会话输入动作接在一起，减少另开页面与手打选项。若数字、草稿、提交回执或保存状态不明，应停止卡片动作并退回文字输入和已验证的外部表单。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)/[Q05](#research-q05)图表/表单对象与静态结果可核，50%超25%泛UI；真实需求/效果未验不达75%。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)-[Q03](#research-q03)会话内卡片/action超0无差异，25%；回执/保存/SDK安全与成本未知不达50%稳定相对收益。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)-[Q04](#research-q04)真systemPrompt/SDK render/script/submit/保存失败链已核，50%超25%声明；未运行/SDK内部/Host认证与业务结果不达75%。

cost.rationale: [Q03](#research-q03)-[Q05](#research-q05)Token/状态隐私/SDK兼容和失败维护重，25%不达50%轻负担；静态脱敏/手打退路超0。

      "content": "# dsh-genui\n\n**English** · [简体中文](https://github.com/lhuans/dsh-genui/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)\n\n> Turn [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) replies from a wall of text into an interface you can actually click.\n\nYou ask the AI to run a calculation and get back a formula. You ask it to file a request and get eight Markdown bullets. You ask about last week's traffic and get numbers lined up as plain text.\n\nNothing is wrong — but you still do the work yourself: copy, paste, do the math in your head, then type another message saying \"I'll take the second one.\"\n\n**dsh-genui** is a plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Install it, ask the same questions, and the answer grows a real interface: calculator keys you can press, dropdowns you can pick from, charts with actual axes. Whatever you click or fill in flows back into the conversation, and the AI picks up from there.\n\nOne command to install. No changes to DSH source.\n\n---\n\n## Three real examples\n\nAll three screenshots are from a live DSH session — not mockups.\n\n### \"Generate a calculator\"\n\n![A calculator rendered inside a DSH conversation](./public/computer.webp)\n\nDigits, operators, parentheses, backspace, clear — every key works. That 666 was typed on the keypad, not written into the text by the model.\n\n### \"Generate a form\"\n\n![A project proposal form rendered inside a DSH conversation](./public/form.webp)\n\nOne sentence produces a full project proposal form: required-field validation, radio group, dropdown, headcount stepper, date picker, toggle, checkboxes, long text.\n\nHit **Submit** and your answers go back into the conversation, so the AI can rank the priority, draft a schedule, or write the proposal for you.\n\n### \"Show the last 7 days of traffic as a line chart\"\n\n![A traffic line chart rendered inside a DSH conversation](./public/chat.webp)\n\nTwo series, legend, axes, gridlines — a rendered chart, not ASCII art.\n\n---\n\n## Before and after\n\n| Situation | Plain chat | With dsh-genui |\n|---|---|---|\n| You need a tool | The AI hands you code to run yourself | The tool appears in the reply, usable right away |\n| Collecting input | \"Please provide the following 8 items\", typed one by one | One form: pick, fill, submit |\n| Reading data | Text tables, trends left to imagination | Lines, bars, pies — the trend is obvious |\n| Making a choice | You reply \"option B\" | Click a button, the choice carries into the next turn |\n| Setup cost | — | One `dsh plugin add`, no source changes |\n\n---\n\n## What you can ask for\n\nJust talk normally. You never write JSON or learn a syntax. Each category below includes a prompt you can copy as-is.\n\n### Data: charts\n\nBar, line, pie, ring, radar, gauge, funnel, scatter, waterfall, and other common chart types.\n\n> \"Chart revenue for the last three quarters as bars, and mark year-over-year growth\"\n>\n> \"Show the order split by channel as a pie chart\"\n>\n> \"Build a conversion funnel: 100k impressions, 8k clicks, 600 orders, 520 payments\"\n\nGood for weekly reports, retros, review decks, and anytime you'd rather not open a spreadsheet.\n\n### Input: forms\n\nText fields, textareas, dropdowns, radios, checkboxes, toggles, number steppers, date pickers, search boxes, transfer lists. Submitted values return to the conversation automatically.\n\n> \"Make a time-off request form with leave type, start and end date, days, and reason\"\n>\n> \"Build a survey asking which features people use most and how satisfied they are\"\n>\n> \"Give me a customer intake form, phone number required\"\n\nMuch nicer than being interrogated over eight turns — fill it in once and you're done.\n\n### Tools: little apps\n\nThe fun category. One sentence, and the AI builds you something that actually works.\n\n> \"Generate a calculator\"\n>\n> \"Make a BMI calculator — enter height and weight, get the result\"\n>\n> \"Build a currency converter between USD and CNY\"\n>\n> \"Give me a to-do list for today with checkboxes\"\n>\n> \"Make a raffle picker for the team, I'll paste the names next\"\n\n### Structure: tables, lists, layout\n\nTables (with paging and search), tree views, timelines, breadcrumbs, tabs, collapsible panels, cards, carousels, tooltips.\n\n> \"Put these options in a comparison table: price, timeline, risk\"\n>\n> \"Lay out the project milestones on a timeline\"\n>\n> \"Split the frontend, backend, and QA schedules into tabs\"\n\n### Flow: multi-turn interaction\n\nInteractions travel back to the model, so you can build \"you click, I continue\" flows.\n\n> \"Give me three options as cards — expand whichever one I click\"\n>\n> \"Walk me through a setup wizard, then generate the config file\"\n>\n> \"Quiz me with five multiple-choice questions and grade my answers\"\n\n### One more thing\n\nWhen you're not sure what to ask for, just say \"answer me with an interface\" and let the AI decide whether a chart, a table, or a form fits best.\n\n---\n\n## Install\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js installed\n- `pnpm` installed (DSH uses it to manage plugins). If you don't have it, run `corepack enable` or `npm i -g pnpm`, then **open a new terminal** and check that `pnpm -v` prints a version\n- DSH **0.2.2 or newer, before 0.3** (`dsh --version` reports `0.2.2-rc.1` or a later 0.2 release)\n- DSH running: `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`, default at `http://127.0.0.1:3080`\n\n### Option 1: let the AI install it (easiest if you avoid the terminal)\n\nThe DSH assistant can run shell commands. Open a conversation and tell it:\n\n> Install the dsh-genui plugin from npm into the web profile: run `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-genui`\n\nIt will run the command in front of you, possibly asking you to approve it. Then follow the restart steps below.\n\n### Option 2: run it yourself\n\nIn a new terminal:\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile web add dsh-genui\n```\n\nThis pulls from the public npm registry — no npm account, no cloning the repo.\n\n### Restart afterwards (don't skip this)\n\nDSH locks in its plugin set at startup, so **nothing changes in the UI until you restart**.\n\n1. Go back to the terminal running DSH and press `Ctrl+C`\n2. Start it again: `dsh web`\n3. Refresh the browser\n4. **Start a new conversation**\n\n### GenUI authoring prompt\n\nGenUI authoring starts on 标准 and remembers your last choice across DSH restarts. The sparkle menu in the composer tool row follows DSH's language. In Chinese the tiers are 关闭, 精简, 标准, and 全量; in every other language they are Off, Mini, Standard, and Plus. Off sends no GenUI prompt. Mini is forms, tables, and cards. Standard adds tabs and charts. Plus adds trees, dialogs, and the rest of the component set. Hover an item to read what it includes. Card rendering stays installed either way.\n\n### Check that it worked\n\nIn the new conversation, say:\n\n> Generate a calculator\n\nIf a working calculator appears in the reply, you're set. If you only see a code block, the plugin isn't active — see the FAQ below.\n\nTo verify before restarting:\n\n```sh\ndsh --profile web --dump-config\n```\n\nYou should see a `dsh-genui` layer in the output.\n\n### Uninstall\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-genui\n```\n\nThis also requires a restart to take effect.\n\n---\n\n## FAQ\n\n**Still showing a code block after installing?**\n\nNine times out of ten you skipped the restart or you're still in an old session. Run through all four steps: stop, restart, refresh, new conversation.\n\n**Why do I see raw `<schemaJson>` tags or backticks instead of a rendered card?**\n\nGenUI accepts two formats for the schema block:\n\n- ````schemaJson … ```` (backtick fence — GenUI-native format)\n- `<schemaJson> … </schemaJson>` (XML-style tags — DSH boot-context format)\n\nBoth are rendered identically if the model uses either one. If you see *neither* format rendered and the raw code is visible, the plugin isn't active yet — follow the restart steps above.\n\n**`pnpm not found on PATH`?**\n\nDSH needs pnpm to manage plugins. Run `corepack enable` (or `npm i -g pnpm`), then **open a new terminal** — PATH won't update in the old one.\n\n**The AI doesn't use interfaces on its own?**\n\nIf the sparkle menu is 关闭, the model has no GenUI authoring guidance. Pick 精简, 标准, or 全量, then say something like \"give me a form / chart / interface.\" Charts need 标准 or 全量.\n\n**Does this change how DSH normally works?**\n\nNo. Questions that don't need an interface get regular text answers, exactly as before.\n\n**Does it uninstall cleanly?**\n\nYes. Run `dsh plugin remove`, restart, and DSH is back to its original state with no leftover config.\n\n---\n\n## How it works\n\nIn short: the model no longer writes only text — it also writes a *description of an interface*, and the browser renders that description into real components.\n\nA bit more detail: the plugin adds a prompt section teaching the model to emit structured JSON (inside a `schemaJson` code block) when an interface would help. The composer sparkle menu picks that section's size and starts on 标准. The DSH web client picks up the JSON and hands it to a renderer. It's streaming, so the interface appears as the model writes it — no waiting for the full reply.\n\nThe components come from [OpenTiny GenUI SDK](https://opentiny.design/genui-sdk) and the OpenTiny Vue library — OpenTiny's generative-UI stack, a spec plus rendering engine for letting LLMs produce interfaces. dsh-genui wires that into the DSH conversation flow.\n\nOn safety: the model can only use whitelisted components. It cannot inject HTML or scripts, so nothing strange ends up in your conversation.\n\n---\n\n## Links\n\n- Changelog: <https://github.com/lhuans/dsh-genui/releases>\n- npm package: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-genui>\n- OpenTiny GenUI SDK: <https://github.com/opentiny/genui-sdk>\n- DeepSeek Harness: <https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness>\n\nLicense: MIT\n\n---\n\nDSH handles agents, sessions, and tools. dsh-genui adds the last piece: replies you can click, not just read.\n\nOne command, one restart, then say \"generate a calculator\" — thirty seconds to see the difference.\n"

      "content": "# dsh-genui\n\n[English](https://github.com/lhuans/dsh-genui/blob/main/README.md) · **简体中文**\n\n> 让 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的回答，从「一段文字」变成「一个能点的界面」。\n\n你问 AI「帮我算一下」，它回你一串公式；你说「我要填个申请」，它给你列了八条 Markdown；你说「看看最近七天的访问量」，它把数字排成一张纯文本表格。\n\n内容都对，但你还得自己动手：复制、粘贴、心算、再打一段字告诉它「我选第二个」。\n\n**dsh-genui** 是一个 DeepSeek Harness（下称 DSH）插件。装上之后，同样的问题，AI 的回答里会直接长出一个真的界面——计算器的按键能按，表单的下拉能选，图表的坐标轴是画出来的。你在界面上点完、填完，结果会自动回到对话里，AI 接着往下聊。\n\n装它只要一行命令，不用改 DSH 的任何源码。\n\n---\n\n## 先看三个真实例子\n\n下面三张都是 DSH 里的实际截图，不是效果图。\n\n### 说「生成一个计算器」\n\n![DSH 对话里渲染出的计算器](./public/computer.webp)\n\n数字键、四则运算、括号、退格、清空，全都能按。算出来的 666 是真按出来的，不是 AI 写在文字里的。\n\n### 说「生成一个表单」\n\n![DSH 对话里渲染出的项目立项申请表](./public/form.webp)\n\n一句话生成一整张立项申请表：必填校验、单选按钮组、下拉框、人数步进器、日期选择、开关、多选框、长文本，一次到位。\n\n填完点「提交申请」，你填的内容会带回对话里，AI 可以接着帮你判断优先级、生成排期，或者直接写成一份立项说明。\n\n### 说「用折线图展示最近 7 天访问量」\n\n![DSH 对话里渲染出的访问量折线图](./public/chat.webp)\n\n双折线、图例、坐标轴、网格线，都是渲染出来的图，不是字符画。\n\n---\n\n## 装之前 vs 装之后\n\n| 场景 | 普通对话 | 装了 dsh-genui |\n|---|---|---|\n| 要一个工具 | AI 给你一段代码，你自己去跑 | 工具直接出现在回答里，当场就能用 |\n| 收集信息 | AI 列出「请提供以下 8 项」，你一条条打字 | 一张表单，选完填完点提交 |\n| 看数据 | 文本表格，趋势靠脑补 | 折线、柱状、饼图，一眼看出走势 |\n| 做选择 | 你回一句「我选 B」 | 点一下按钮，选择自动进入下一轮 |\n| 接入成本 | — | 一行 `dsh plugin add`，不动 DSH 源码 |\n\n---\n\n## 你可以让它做什么\n\n只要在对话里正常说人话就行，不需要写任何 JSON、也不用背语法。下面每一类都附了一句可以直接复制的话。\n\n### 看数据：图表\n\n支持柱状图、折线图、饼图、环形图、雷达图、仪表盘、漏斗图、散点图、瀑布图等常见图形。\n\n> 「把这三个季度的营收画成柱状图，顺便标出同比」\n>\n> 「用饼图看看各渠道的订单占比」\n>\n> 「做个转化漏斗：曝光 10 万、点击 8 千、下单 600、支付 520」\n\n适合周报、复盘、汇报材料，以及「我懒得开 Excel」的时候。\n\n### 收信息：表单\n\n输入框、多行文本、下拉、单选、多选、开关、数字步进、日期选择、搜索框、穿梭框，都可以生成。提交后内容自动回到对话。\n\n> 「生成一张请假申请表，要有请假类型、起止日期、天数和事由」\n>\n> 「做个问卷，问用户最常用哪几个功能、满意度打几分」\n>\n> 「帮我做一个客户信息录入表，手机号必填」\n\n比 AI 追问你八轮舒服得多——一次填完就行。\n\n### 做工具：小应用\n\n这是最好玩的一类。用一句话，让 AI 当场给你造个能用的小东西。\n\n> 「生成一个计算器」\n>\n> 「做一个 BMI 计算器，输入身高体重直接出结果」\n>\n> 「做个汇率换算的小工具，人民币和美元互转」\n>\n> 「弄一个今天的待办清单，可以勾选完成」\n>\n> 「做一个团队抽奖器，名单我等下给你」\n\n### 理内容：表格、清单、结构\n\n表格（带分页和搜索）、树形目录、时间线、面包屑、标签页、折叠面板、卡片、走马灯、气泡提示。\n\n> 「把这几个方案做成对比表，横向对比价格、周期和风险」\n>\n> 「按时间线梳理一下这个项目的关键节点」\n>\n> 「用标签页分开展示前端、后端、测试三块的排期」\n\n### 走流程：多轮交互\n\n界面上的操作会回到对话里，所以可以做「你点一下、我接着干」的流程。\n\n> 「给我三个方案，做成卡片，我点哪个你就展开细化哪个」\n>\n> 「做个配置向导，一步步问我需求，最后生成配置文件」\n>\n> 「出五道选择题考考我，我选完你告诉我对错」\n\n### 顺手一提\n\n想不到要什么的时候，直接说「用界面的方式回答我」，AI 会自己判断该用图、用表还是用表单。\n\n---\n\n## 怎么装\n\n### 准备工作\n\n- 装好 Node.js\n- 装好 `pnpm`（DSH 管理插件时要用它）。没有的话执行 `corepack enable` 或 `npm i -g pnpm`，然后**新开一个终端**，确认 `pnpm -v` 有输出\n- DSH **0.2.2 及以上、0.3 之前**（`dsh --version` 为 `0.2.2-rc.1` 或同系列更新版本）\n- DSH 能跑起来：`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`，默认地址 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`\n\n### 方式一：让 AI 帮你装（推荐给不常用命令行的人）\n\nDSH 里的助手本身就能执行终端命令。打开对话，直接跟它说：\n\n> 帮我把 npm 上的 dsh-genui 插件装到 web profile，执行 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-genui`\n\n它会把命令跑给你看，中间可能要你点一下确认。跑完之后，按下面「重启」那步操作即可。\n\n### 方式二：自己敲命令\n\n新开一个终端：\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile web add dsh-genui\n```\n\n这条命令从 npm 公开仓库拉取安装，不需要 npm 账号，也不需要 clone 仓库。\n\n### 装完必须重启（这一步别跳）\n\nDSH 在启动时就锁定了当前的插件集合，所以**装完插件不重启，界面上什么都不会变**。\n\n1. 回到跑着 DSH 的那个终端，按 `Ctrl+C` 停掉\n2. 重新启动：`dsh web`\n3. 浏览器刷新一下页面\n4. **开一个新会话**\n\n### GenUI 提示词\n\nGenUI 提示词默认是「标准」，并且会记住你上一次的选择。输入框工具行里的星形菜单可以选关闭、精简、标准、全量（界面语言不是中文时显示为 Off、Mini、Standard、Plus），悬停可看每一档的说明。关闭时不注入提示词。精简覆盖表单、表格和卡片；标准再加标签页和图表；全量再加树、弹窗等其余组件。它只控制发给模型的提示词，卡片渲染能力始终保留。\n\n### 验证装好了没\n\n在新会话里说一句：\n\n> 生成一个计算器\n\n如果回答区域直接出现一个能按的计算器，就成了。如果只看到一段代码块，说明插件没生效，往下看「常见问题」。\n\n想在重启前先确认一下，可以执行：\n\n```sh\ndsh --profile web --dump-config\n```\n\n输出里应该能看到 `dsh-genui` 这一层。\n\n### 不想要了\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-genui\n```\n\n同样需要重启 DSH 才会生效。\n\n---\n\n## 常见问题\n\n**装完还是显示成代码块？**\n\n九成是没重启，或者还在用旧会话。按上面「装完必须重启」的四步走一遍：停服务 → 重启 → 刷新浏览器 → 开新会话。\n\n**提示 `pnpm not found on PATH`？**\n\nDSH 管理插件依赖 pnpm。执行 `corepack enable`（或 `npm i -g pnpm`）之后，**新开一个终端**再试，因为 PATH 在旧终端里不会更新。\n\n**AI 不主动用界面回答？**\n\n如果星形菜单是「关闭」，模型不会收到 GenUI 提示词。改成精简、标准或全量，再说一句「用界面/表单/图表的方式给我」就行。图表需要标准或全量。\n\n**会不会影响原来的用法？**\n\n不会。不需要界面的问题，AI 照常用文字回答，和以前一模一样。\n\n**卸载干净吗？**\n\n`dsh plugin remove` 之后重启，DSH 完全恢复原样，不留残留配置。\n\n---\n\n## 它是怎么做到的\n\n一句话：AI 不再只写文字，它还会写一段「界面描述」，浏览器把这段描述渲染成真正的组件。\n\n具体一点：插件默认给模型加一段提示词，教它在需要的时候输出一段结构化的 JSON（写在 `schemaJson` 代码块里）；输入框里的星形菜单选择这段提示词的档位，默认是「标准」。DSH 网页端拿到 JSON 后，交给渲染器变成实际组件。整个过程是流式的，AI 写到哪、界面就渲染到哪，不用等它把话说完。\n\n组件本身来自 [OpenTiny GenUI SDK](https://opentiny.design/genui-sdk) 和 OpenTiny Vue 组件库——这是 OpenTiny 团队做的生成式 UI 方案，一整套「让大模型输出界面」的规范和渲染引擎。dsh-genui 做的事情，是把它接到了 DSH 的对话流里。\n\n顺带说一句安全：模型能用的组件是白名单里的那些，它塞不进 HTML 或脚本，所以不用担心对话里跑出奇怪的东西。\n\n---\n\n## 相关链接\n\n- 更新记录：<https://github.com/lhuans/dsh-genui/releases>\n- npm 包：<https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-genui>\n- OpenTiny GenUI SDK：<https://github.com/opentiny/genui-sdk>\n- DeepSeek Harness：<https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness>\n\nLicense: MIT\n\n---\n\nDSH 管好了 Agent、会话和工具，dsh-genui 补上最后一段：让模型的回答不只是能读，还能点。\n\n一行命令，重启一次，然后跟它说「生成一个计算器」——三十秒就能看到区别。\n"

      "content": "import { RepairJsonState, repairJson } from '@opentiny/genui-sdk-core'\n\n/** DSH dark-mode marker on `<body>`. */\nexport const DARK_ATTR = 'data-ds-dark-theme'\n\n/** Whether the DSH host is currently in dark mode. */\nexport function isDarkMode(): boolean {\n  return typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.body?.hasAttribute(DARK_ATTR) === true\n}\n\nfunction isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {\n  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)\n}\n\n/**\n * Copy the schema and set the chart theme on every HuiCharts component.\n * Charts render to canvas and do not inherit the ConfigProvider CSS theme.\n */\nexport function applyChartTheme(value: unknown, dark: boolean): unknown {\n  const themeName = dark ? 'cloud-dark' : 'cloud-light'\n\n  function walk(node: unknown): unknown {\n    if (Array.isArray(node)) return node.map(walk)\n    if (!isPlainObject(node)) return node\n\n    const next: Record<string, unknown> = { ...node }\n    for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(node)) {\n      next[key] = walk(child)\n    }\n\n    const componentName = typeof next.componentName === 'string' ? next.componentName : ''\n    if (componentName.startsWith('TinyHuicharts')) {\n      const props = isPlainObject(next.props) ? { ...next.props } : {}\n      const options = isPlainObject(props.options) ? { ...props.options } : {}\n      options.theme = themeName\n      next.props = { ...props, options }\n    }\n\n    return next\n  }\n\n  return walk(value)\n}\n\n/**\n * Parse with the SDK's stream repairer so charts can receive a themed schema\n * before the final chunk. If repair cannot produce an object, hand the\n * original string back to GenuiRenderer and let it show its normal error.\n */\nexport function parseThemedContent(\n  content: string | Record<string, unknown>,\n  dark: boolean,\n  isJsonComplete = true,\n): { content: string | Record<string, unknown>; isJsonComplete: boolean } {\n  if (typeof content !== 'string') {\n    return { content: applyChartTheme(content, dark) as Record<string, unknown>, isJsonComplete }\n  }\n  if (!content.trim()) return { content: {}, isJsonComplete: true }\n\n  const repaired = repairJson(content)\n  if (!repaired.value || typeof repaired.value !== 'object') {\n    return { content, isJsonComplete }\n  }\n\n  return {\n    content: applyChartTheme(repaired.value, dark) as Record<string, unknown>,\n    isJsonComplete: repaired.state === RepairJsonState.SUCCESS,\n  }\n}\n"

      "content": "import { DSH_GENUI_CARD_TAG } from './genui-card-tag.ts'\nimport { GENUI_RUNTIME_URL } from '../genui-runtime-url.ts'\n\nlet loading: Promise<void> | undefined\n\nfunction alreadyDefined(): boolean {\n  return typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && customElements.get(DSH_GENUI_CARD_TAG) !== undefined\n}\n\n/**\n * Fetch and evaluate the Vue/OpenTiny custom-element bundle.\n * Concurrent callers share one in-flight request; a failed load can retry.\n */\nexport function loadGenuiRuntime(): Promise<void> {\n  if (alreadyDefined()) return Promise.resolve()\n  if (loading !== undefined) return loading\n  if (typeof document === 'undefined') {\n    return Promise.reject(new Error('dsh-genui: Vue runtime requires a document'))\n  }\n  loading = new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {\n    const script = document.createElement('script')\n    script.type = 'module'\n    script.src = GENUI_RUNTIME_URL\n    script.addEventListener('load', () => resolve(), { once: true })\n    script.addEventListener('error', () => {\n      loading = undefined\n      script.remove()\n      reject(new Error(`dsh-genui: failed to load ${GENUI_RUNTIME_URL}`))\n    }, { once: true })\n    document.head.appendChild(script)\n  }).then(() => {\n    if (!alreadyDefined()) {\n      loading = undefined\n      throw new Error('dsh-genui: Vue runtime loaded but <dsh-genui-card> was not defined')\n    }\n  })\n  return loading\n}\n\n/** Kick off {@link loadGenuiRuntime} without blocking plugin registration. */\nexport function prefetchGenuiRuntime(): void {\n  const start = (): void => {\n    void loadGenuiRuntime().catch(() => {\n      // First-card render will retry; boot must not surface a rejected idle task.\n    })\n  }\n  if (typeof requestIdleCallback === 'function') requestIdleCallback(start)\n  else setTimeout(start, 0)\n}\n"

      "content": "import { useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'\nimport { createPortal } from 'react-dom'\nimport * as primitives from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives'\nimport { GENUI_PROMPT_CONTROL_URL } from '../prompt-control-url.ts'\nimport {\n  isGenuiPromptMode,\n  type GenuiPromptMode,\n} from '../prompt-mode.ts'\nimport {\n  PROMPT_MODE_MENU_MODES,\n  promptModeOptionKey,\n  promptModeText,\n  type PromptModeCopyKey,\n} from './prompt-mode-copy.ts'\nimport { pickSparkleIcon } from './sparkle-icon.ts'\nimport css from './prompt-toggle-button.module.css'\n\n/** Composer slot props; `t` is present when the host installed the locale seat. */\nexport type PromptToggleButtonProps = {\n  t?: (key: string) => string\n}\n\n/**\n * Choose the GenUI authoring prompt tier from the composer tool row.\n * Rendering stays installed either way;       "content": "/**\n * Split assistant markdown into prose vs ```schemaJson card payloads.\n * Complete fences become schema segments; while streaming or interrupted, a\n * trailing open fence is treated as an incomplete schema segment for\n * GenuiRenderer.\n */\n\n/** One display segment after schemaJson extraction. */\nexport type TextSegment =\n  | { readonly kind: 'markdown'; readonly text: string }\n  | { readonly kind: 'schema'; readonly text: string; readonly complete: boolean }\n\n/**\n * Parse both backtick fences and XML-style tags so the plugin works whether\n * the model emits ```schemaJson … ``` (the GenUI-native syntax) or\n * <schemaJson> … </schemaJson> (the DSH boot-context syntax). Both formats\n * are common; accepting either prevents silent rendering failures.\n *\n * Examples of either format that genui recognizes:\n *\n *   ```schemaJson\n *   { \"componentName\": \"Page\" }\n *   ```\n *\n *   <schemaJson>\n *   { \"componentName\": \"Page\" }\n *   </schemaJson>\n */\n\n// Backtick-fence format (GenUI-native)\nconst COMPLETE_FENCE = /```schemaJson\\s*\\r?\\n?([\\s\\S]*?)```/g\nconst OPEN_FENCE = /```schemaJson\\s*\\r?\\n?([\\s\\S]*)$/\n\n// XML-tag format (DSH boot-context fallback)\nconst COMPLETE_TAG = /<schemaJson>\\s*\\r?\\n?([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/schemaJson>/g\nconst OPEN_TAG = /<schemaJson>\\s*\\r?\\n?([\\s\\S]*)$/\n\n/**\n * Split assistant text into markdown and schema-card segments.\n * @param text - full assistant text block (streaming or final).\n * @param streaming - whether the turn is still generating.\n * @param interrupted - whether generation was stopped after partial content.\n * @returns ordered segments for mixed markdown + GenUI rendering.\n */\nexport function splitAssistantText(text: string, streaming: boolean, interrupted = false): TextSegment[] {\n  const live = streaming || interrupted\n  const segments: TextSegment[] = []\n\n  // Collect matches from both formats, deduplicated by position.\n  const matches: Array<{ index: number; end: number; text: string }> = []\n\n  // Check for backtick-fence format\n  COMPLETE_FENCE.lastIndex = 0\n  for (const match of text.matchAll(COMPLETE_FENCE)) {\n    matches.push({ index: match.index ?? 0, end: (match.index ?? 0) + match[0].length, text: match[1] ?? '' })\n  }\n\n  // Check for XML-tag format\n  COMPLETE_TAG.lastIndex = 0\n  for (const match of text.matchAll(COMPLETE_TAG)) {\n    matches.push({ index: match.index ?? 0, end: (match.index ?? 0) + match[0].length, text: match[1] ?? '' })\n  }\n\n  // Sort by position and deduplicate (if both formats overlap, first wins — backtick fence format was found first above)\n  matches.sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index)\n  const unique: typeof matches = []\n  let lastEnd = -1\n  for (const m of matches) {\n    if (m.index >= lastEnd) {\n      unique.push(m)\n      lastEnd = m.end\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Build segments from unique matches, merging consecutive schema blocks\n  // into a JSON array so the Vue renderer mounts a single card (avoiding\n  // the DSH client streaming-reconciliation crash that happens when\n  // multiple cards are mounted in one turn).\n  let last = 0\n  let schemaBuffer: string[] = []\n  function flushSchemaBuffer() {\n    if (schemaBuffer.length === 0) return\n    const merged = schemaBuffer.length === 1\n      ? schemaBuffer[0]\n      : '[' + schemaBuffer.join(',') + ']'\n    segments.push({ kind: 'schema', text: merged, complete: true })\n    schemaBuffer = []\n  }\n  for (const { index, end, text: content } of unique) {\n    if (index > last) {\n      flushSchemaBuffer()\n      segments.push({ kind: 'markdown', text: text.slice(last, index) })\n    }\n    schemaBuffer.push(content)\n    last = end\n  }\n  flushSchemaBuffer()\n\n  const rest = text.slice(last)\n  if (rest.length === 0) return segments\n  if (live) {\n    // Check for open backtick fence\n    const open = OPEN_FENCE.exec(rest)\n    if (open !== null && open.index !== undefined) {\n      const before = rest.slice(0, open.index)\n      if (before.length > 0) segments.push({ kind: 'markdown', text: before })\n      segments.push({ kind: 'schema', text: open[1] ?? '', complete: false })\n      return segments\n    }\n    // Check for open XML tag\n    const openTag = OPEN_TAG.exec(rest)\n    if (openTag !== null && openTag.index !== undefined) {\n      const before = rest.slice(0, openTag.index)\n      if (before.length > 0) segments.push({ kind: 'markdown', text: before })\n      segments.push({ kind: 'schema', text: openTag[1] ?? '', complete: false })\n      return segments\n    }\n  }\n  segments.push({ kind: 'markdown', text: rest })\n  return segments\n}\n"

      "content": "/**\n * Host half: injects the GenUI card-authoring system-prompt section so the\n * model emits ```schemaJson fences alongside normal markdown.\n */\nimport type { IncomingMessage, ServerResponse } from 'node:http'\nimport type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport z from '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'\nimport {\n  materialsMeta,\n  miniMaterialsMeta,\n  plusMaterialsMeta,\n} from '@opentiny/genui-sdk-materials-vue-opentiny-vue/meta'\nimport { genPrompt, type IGenPromptCustomConfig, type IMaterialsMeta } from '@opentiny/genui-sdk-core'\nimport {\n  createGenuiPromptControl,\n  createGenuiPromptControlHandler,\n  createPersistedPromptControl,\n  openPromptSettings,\n  type GenuiPromptControl,\n  type GenuiPromptSettings,\n  type PromptSettingsHost,\n} from './prompt-control.ts'\nimport {\n  DEFAULT_PROMPT_MODE,\n  type GenuiPromptMode,\n} from './prompt-mode.ts'\nimport { adjustAuthoringPrompt } from './authoring-prompt.ts'\nimport { GENUI_PROMPT_CONTROL_URL } from './prompt-control-url.ts'\nimport {\n  GENUI_RUNTIME_MAP_URL,\n  GENUI_RUNTIME_URL,\n  genuiRuntimeArtifactPaths,\n  serveStaticFile,\n} from './serve-genui-runtime.ts'\n\nexport const name = 'dsh-genui'\nexport const inject = ['systemPrompt', 'webServer']\n\ndeclare global {\n  namespace Schemastery {\n    interface Meta<T = any> {\n      /** DSH 0.2 settings writes only fields marked volatile. */\n      volatile?: boolean\n    }\n  }\n}\n\ninterface WebServer {\n  register(route: {\n    kind: 'exact' | 'prefix'\n    path: string\n    handler: (req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse) => void | Promise<void>\n  }): () => void\n}\n\n/** Tunables for the GenUI prompt section. */\nexport interface Config {\n  /** Registry order among system-prompt sections (higher = later). */\n  sectionOrder: number\n  /** Stable section name in the prompt registry. */\n  sectionName: string\n  /**\n   * Legacy on/off toggle. Pass a short message only; the host appends the card state (formData, etc.) automatically.',\n      parameters: {\n        type: 'object',\n        properties: {\n          message: {\n            type: 'string',\n            description: 'Short follow-up text (button label or summary). disposal keeps a reloaded plugin from leaking the section.\n  ctx.effect(() => {\n    promptControl.set(DEFAULT_PROMPT_MODE)\n    return () => promptControl.set('off')\n  }, 'dsh-genui: prompt mode state')\n\n  ctx.inject(['settings'], (settingsCtx) => {\n    const settings = (settingsCtx as Context & { settings: PromptSettingsHost }).settings\n    const scope = openPromptSettings(settings, {\n      configMode: config.promptMode,\n      configEnabled: config.promptEnabled !== false,\n      schema: PromptSettings,\n    })\n    if (scope === undefined) {\n      ctx.logger.warn('dsh-genui: prompt mode will not persist')\n      return\n    }\n    ctx.logger.debug('dsh-genui: settings service attached')\n    settingsCtx.effect(() => {\n      // Persist explicit choices, but never write the unload-time cleanup state.\n      const persistedControl = createPersistedPromptControl(promptControl, scope, DEFAULT_PROMPT_MODE, error => {\n        ctx.logger.warn('dsh-genui: failed to persist prompt state', error)\n      }, mode => {\n        ctx.logger.debug('dsh-genui: persisting prompt state mode=%s', mode)\n      })\n      currentControl = persistedControl\n      persistedAttached = true\n      return () => {\n        currentControl = promptControl\n        persistedAttached = false\n      }\n    }, 'dsh-genui: persisted prompt control')\n  })\n\n  const artifacts = genuiRuntimeArtifactPaths()\n  const webServer = (ctx as Context & { webServer: WebServer }).webServer\n  ctx.effect(\n    () => webServer.register({\n      kind: 'exact',\n      path: GENUI_PROMPT_CONTROL_URL,\n      handler: createGenuiPromptControlHandler(endpointControl),\n    }),\n    'dsh-genui: prompt mode endpoint',\n  )\n  ctx.effect(\n    () => webServer.register({\n      kind: 'exact',\n      path: GENUI_RUNTIME_URL,\n      handler: serveStaticFile(artifacts.js, 'text/javascript;       "content": "import type { IncomingMessage, ServerResponse } from 'node:http'\nimport {\n  isGenuiPromptMode,\n  resolvePromptMode,\n  type GenuiActivePromptMode,\n  type GenuiPromptMode,\n} from './prompt-mode.ts'\n\n/** The minimal system-prompt registry face used by the composer control. */\nexport interface GenuiSystemPrompt {\n  section(section: { name: string; order: number; text: string }): () => void\n}\n\n/** Registers and disposes one prompt section without leaking it on unload. */\nexport interface GenuiPromptControl {\n  /** Active tier. `off` means the section is not in the registry. */\n  mode(): GenuiPromptMode\n  /** Whether a prompt section is currently registered. */\n  isEnabled(): boolean\n  /** Set the desired tier and return the resulting tier. */\n  set(mode: GenuiPromptMode): GenuiPromptMode\n}\n\n/** The persisted slice of prompt-mode state in DSH settings. */\nexport interface GenuiPromptSettings {\n  /** Selected tier, once the dropdown has been used or a new config is stored. */\n  mode?: GenuiPromptMode\n  /**\n   * Legacy on/off toggle. `false` means off when `mode` is absent.\n   * New writes set this to `mode !== 'off'` so older hosts still find the field.\n   */\n  enabled?: boolean\n}\n\n/** One settings form row, as returned by DSH 0.2 `settings.describe()`. */\nexport interface PromptSettingsDescriptor {\n  ns: string\n  value: unknown\n  schema: unknown\n}\n\n/** Fields written into the plugin Config on DSH 0.2. */\nexport interface PromptConfigPatch {\n  promptMode: GenuiPromptMode\n  promptEnabled: boolean\n}\n\n/**\n * Host settings seam. DSH 0.1 exposes `register`; DSH 0.2 exposes `describe` / `update`\n * and only accepts fields marked volatile on the plugin Config.\n */\nexport interface PromptSettingsHost {\n  register?: (namespace: string, schema: unknown) => GenuiPromptSettingsScope\n  describe?: () => readonly PromptSettingsDescriptor[]\n  update?: (ns: string, patch: PromptConfigPatch) => Promise<void>\n}\n\nconst PROMPT_ENTRY_PREFERENCE = ['genui', 'dsh-genui']\n\n/**\n * Pick the profile entry that owns this plugin's live prompt fields.\n * The bundled patch uses `genui`; a hand-written entry may use the package name.\n * @param descriptors - rows from `settings.describe()`.\n * @returns The entry id to pass to `settings.update`, when one row is ours.\n */\nexport function findPromptSettingsEntry(descriptors: readonly PromptSettingsDescriptor[]): string | undefined {\n  const matches = descriptors.filter(mentionsPromptSettings)\n  for (const id of PROMPT_ENTRY_PREFERENCE) {\n    if (matches.some(descriptor => descriptor.ns === id)) return id\n  }\n  return matches.length === 1 ? matches[0]?.ns : undefined\n}\n\nfunction mentionsPromptSettings(descriptor: PromptSettingsDescriptor): boolean {\n  const value = descriptor.value\n  if (value !== null && typeof value === 'object') {\n    if ('promptEnabled' in value || 'promptMode' in value) return true\n  }\n  const schema = JSON.stringify(descriptor.schema ?? null)\n  return schema.includes('\"promptEnabled\"') || schema.includes('\"promptMode\"')\n}\n\n/**\n * Open the settings scope for the prompt mode.\n * @param settings - host settings service.\n * @param options.configMode - resolved Config `promptMode`, when one was stored.\n * @param options.configEnabled - resolved Config `promptEnabled`.\n * @param options.schema - legacy `settings.register` schema.\n * @returns A get/update scope, or undefined when this host cannot persist the choice.\n */\nexport function openPromptSettings(\n  settings: PromptSettingsHost,\n  options: { configMode?: unknown; configEnabled: boolean; schema: unknown },\n): GenuiPromptSettingsScope | undefined {\n  if (typeof settings.register === 'function') {\n    return settings.register('dsh-genui', options.schema)\n  }\n  if (typeof settings.update !== 'function') return undefined\n  const update = settings.update.bind(settings)\n  return {\n    get: () => ({\n      mode: isGenuiPromptMode(options.configMode) ?
